description: This file contains unit tests for various utility functions in the SuiteCRM project, including string retrieval, encoding, language settings, user roles, PHP version checks, and security functions.

classes.name: UtilsTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class testing various utility functions used within the SuiteCRM application.

methods.name: testGetAppString
methods.description: Tests retrieval of application strings including default, empty, and existing labels.

methods.name: testencodeMultienumValue
methods.description: Tests encoding of multienumeration array values into string format.

methods.name: testunencodeMultienum
methods.description: Tests decoding of multienumeration strings back into arrays.

methods.name: testget_languages
methods.description: Tests retrieval of language mappings and display names.

methods.name: testget_current_language
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the current language considering session and default config.

methods.name: testcheck_php_version
methods.description: Tests PHP version comparison against minimum and recommended versions.

methods.name: testreturn_bytes
methods.description: Tests conversion of size strings to byte counts.

methods.name: testSecureXSS
methods.description: Tests sanitization of a string to prevent XSS.
